title: Concept: IIS default start page served
description: The default IIS start page or its placeholder image in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The default page confirms an unconfigured site, and it is usually accompanied by directory browsing and detailed errors from the same host.
applicability: Deployments that render the default IIS start page or its placeholder image into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The default page confirms an unconfigured site, and it is usually accompanied by directory browsing and detailed errors from the same host.
